title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:HIGH/LOW BEAM DIMMER (116 affected)
summary: CARS WERE BUILT MISSING A WIRE BETWEEN THE DIGITAL CLUSTER AND THE DIMMER CONTROL, THEREBY FAILING TO PROVIDE AT LEAST TWO LEVELS OF LIGHTING.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (14,387 affected)
summary: CHILD RESTRAINT FAILED HEAD AND KNEE EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: HEATER:ELECTRICAL:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:FAN MOTOR (515 affected)
Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEATS (278,000 affected)
summary: THE POWER SEAT SWITCH WIRING IS ROUTED OVER RATHER THAN UNDER THE FRONT SEAT SUPPORT BRACE, ALLOWING DAMAGE BY SEAT CUSHION SPRING ENDS WHEN SEAT IS OCCUPIED.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: HEATER:WATER:DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER:CIRCUIT BREAKER FU (30,000 affected)
summary: FUSE BLOCK WIRING TERMINALS MAY NOT ADEQUATELY CLAMP THE POSITIVE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION OF HEATER BLOWER MOTOR FUSE BLADES.

title: STARCRAFT COMPANY: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN (1,801 affected)
summary: SEAT PEDESTALS ON MIDSHIP SEATS WERE IMPROPERLY WELDED; THIS FAILURE OF THE SEAT BASE ADDS TO THE LOAD ON THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE, WHICH IN TURN CAUSES A FAILURE TO MEET THE FMVSS 210 STANDARDS.

title: STARCRAFT COMPANY: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN (444 affected)
summary: INCORRECT SEAT BASE WELDS ON THE DRIVER AND FRONT PASSENGER SEATS CAUSES FAILURES OF THE SEAT BASE, AND CONSEQUENT FAILURE OF THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGES, WHICH DOES NOT MEET THE FMVSS 210 STANDARDS.

title: REMINGTON TIRE CO.: TIRES (262 affected)
summary: TIRES WERE MOLDED WITH PROPER TUBE-TYPE LABEL, BUT MARKED TUBELESS.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:BENCH (25,807 affected)
summary: SEAT BACK OF THE REAR BENCH SEAT MAY BREAK AWAY FROM THE SEAT CUSHION IN AN ACCIDENT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL (1,300 affected)
summary: INCORRECT TURN SIGNAL FLASHER INHIBITS INDICATION OF SIGNAL LAMP OUTAGE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:OTHER PART (5,500 affected)
summary: ROUTING OF BATTERY MAIN FEED WIRING MAY ALLOW IT TO CONTACT THE AIR CLEANER BRACKET AND CONTNUED CONTACT MAY LEAD TO AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: HEBCO PRODUCTS, INC.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (3,200 affected)
summary: THE AIR BRAKE HOSE OF THE ASSEMBLY DOES NOT MEET ADHESION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 106.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS (77 affected)
summary: AIR BRAKE SYSTEM WAS MODIFIED BY ADDING A LONGER AIR LINE BETWEEN THE ABS SOLENOID AND THE TRANSFER TEE TO SIMPLIFY MANUFACTURING. THIS MODIFICATION CAUSED THE TRUCKS TO BE IN NON-COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 121, BRAKE TIMING TEST.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SWAY BAR (5,623 affected)
summary: REAR AXLE STABILIZER (SWAY) BAR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY HEAT TREATED.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (400 affected)
summary: A RIGHT HAND SEAT/SHOULDER BELT RETRACTOR MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE SECOND ROW LEFT HAND SEAT POSITION (DIRECTLY BEHIND DRIVER).

title: Ford Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (6,800 affected)
summary: THE PARK ROD ASSEMBLY CONTAINS A PARK CAM WITH INADEQUATE SURFACE HARDNESS, WHICH COULD LEAD TO PARK DISENGAGEMENT OR NO PARK ENGAGEMENT WHEN THE LEVER IS PLACED IN PARK.

title: NATIONAL COACH CORP.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDAL (64 affected)
summary: BRAKE PEDAL TRAVEL BEYOND HALF THE DISTANCE TO THE FLOOR IS IMPAIRED DUE TO THE MOUNTING OF A MURPHY THROTTLE INTERLOCK SOLENOID BETWEEN THE BRAKE PEDAL SHAFT AND FLOORBOARD.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:FRONT SEAT:MAN (12,659 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER'S SEAT AND THE PASSENGER FRONT OUTBOARD OCCUPANT SEAT ARE DESIGNED WITH THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE ON THE SEAT STRUCTURE. THE WELDS ON THE ALUMINUM WELD MOUNT ASSEMBLY ATTACHING THE SEAT PEDESTAL TO THE CHASSIS COULD FRACTURE IN AN ACCIDENT AND WOULD NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207 AND FMVSS 210.
